consequences: A new command needs a line in the groups map in packages/cli/src/index.ts, or it shows under OTHER. A renderer that wants layout must check term().rich and keep its plain branch unchanged. Shell completions, a pager and interactive pickers were not built (docs/ideas.md).
context: Owner asked 2026-11-11 for a production-ready redesign of CLI output. Output had no colour, alignment or width handling; citty's help printed colour codes into a pipe and listed 37 commands on one usage line; record text from teammates and agents was printed raw.
decision: 1. Two layouts chosen by stdout.isTTY (or FORCE_COLOR): aligned, coloured, wrapped for a person; the previous compact lines, byte for byte, for a pipe. Rejected: one rich layout everywhere, because agents and scripts read piped output and pay for every character. 2. No colour or table dependency: packages/cli/src/term.ts holds the SGR codes, width, wrap and table. Rejected: adding picocolors/cli-table, which would be a tech-stack change for about 300 lines. 3. citty still parses arguments, but help is rendered by packages/cli/src/help.ts and main.ts no longer calls citty's runMain/showUsage. 4. Text output passes through cleanDeep() in output(): escape sequences, C0/C1 controls and bidirectional overrides are removed. --json is not cleaned. 5. Brief fit() trims to a per-section floor (2; Ready 5) before trimming any section to nothing.
title: CLI output: rich layout for a terminal, compact lines for a pipe; own help renderer; stored text cleaned
